cues.en: This video certainly won't be very dry.
cues.zh: 这期视频肯定不会太“干”。

cues.en: I've had a bit of an epiphany in recent days.
cues.zh: 最近几天我有点顿悟。

cues.en: See, over the summer, I made a video about this stupid thing. You can check it out if you like, links are in all the places, but as a quick recap, this is what purports to be a personal air conditioner but in fact it's a teeny tiny evaporative cooler, also known as a swamp cooler.
cues.zh: 是这样，夏天我做过一期视频，讲这个蠢东西。感兴趣可以去看，链接到处都是；简单回顾一下：这东西号称是个人空调，其实是个超小的蒸发式冷却器，也叫沼泽冷却器。

cues.en: And that's why they're,
cues.zh: 所以它们才——

cues.en: well, silly. Unless you live in a really arid place, adding moisture to the air is exactly the wrong way to achieve cooling.
cues.zh: 嗯，很傻。除非你住在特别干旱的地方，否则给空气加湿恰恰是降温的错误方法。

cues.en: These things are by and large a waste of headspace,
cues.zh: 这些东西基本上就是在浪费脑内空间，

cues.en: desk space,
cues.zh: 桌面空间，

cues.en: and plastic.
cues.zh: 还有塑料。

cues.en: Just
cues.zh: 干脆

cues.en: don't.
cues.zh: 别买。

cues.en: Fast forward to a few weeks ago. Winter's rearing its ugly head here in the Midwest which means the air is getting uncomfortably
cues.zh: 快进到几周前。冬天在中西部又露出丑恶嘴脸，这意味着空气正变得不舒服地

cues.en: dry.
cues.zh: 干燥。

cues.en: I ventured out to the exotic lands of Walmart to buy a cheap humidifier for my bedroom.
cues.zh: 我跑去沃尔玛这个“异国他乡”，给卧室买个便宜加湿器。

cues.en: In fact,
cues.zh: 事实上，

cues.en: this one. Now, it claims to emit invisible cool mist
cues.zh: 就是这个。它声称能喷出看不见的冷雾

cues.en: which,
cues.zh: 这嘛，

cues.en: okay.
cues.zh: 好吧。

cues.en: Sure.
cues.zh: 行吧。

cues.en: I went to set it up and lo and behold, the thing's just a swamp cooler. This is almost uncannily the exact same device as the personal cooler save for a much larger water tank and fan.
cues.zh: 我去安装，结果你猜怎么着，这东西就是个蒸发式冷风机。除了水箱和风扇大得多，它几乎诡异得和那台个人冷风机一模一样。

cues.en: Yep. This thing is almost stupidly simple and I love it. There are three basic parts. The water tank, the body which contains the fan, and the water absorbing matrix.
cues.zh: 没错。这东西简单到离谱，我很喜欢。基本就三部分：水箱、装着风扇的主体，还有吸水基质。

cues.en: The plastic base provides support for the three parts to come together.
cues.zh: 塑料底座把这三部分支撑并组合在一起。

cues.en: The matrix which Equate calls a filter but that's
cues.zh: 这个基质——Equate 管它叫过滤器，但这

cues.en: a silly name, sits in a shallow pool of water and capillary action causes that water to travel up the material and soak the entire thing.
cues.zh: 名字很傻；它放在浅水池里，毛细作用会让水沿着材料往上走，把整块材料浸湿。

cues.en: This wicking action is why more sensible humidifier manufacturers call this John. Sorry. The wick.
cues.zh: 这种吸液作用，就是为什么更明智的加湿器厂商把它叫作 John。抱歉，是吸水芯。

cues.en: In operation,
cues.zh: 工作时，

cues.en: the fan pulls air through the damp wick.
cues.zh: 风扇把空气抽过湿润的吸水芯。

cues.en: The large surface area of the wick helps the water it holds evaporate into the air more quickly, and the fan makes this go even quicker by constantly moving air through it. As the water evaporates, the wick continues to absorb more water. The water tank allows for continuous operation by constantly replenishing the pool of water and keeping it at a consistent height,
cues.zh: 吸水芯的大表面积能让它吸附的水更快蒸发到空气中，而风扇不断让空气穿过吸水芯，使蒸发更快。水蒸发后，吸水芯会继续吸收更多水。水箱通过不断补充水槽中的水并保持水位恒定，实现连续运行，

cues.en: at least until it runs out. Its shape contains a void for the wick and the tank's carrying handle
cues.zh: 至少在水耗尽之前是这样。它的外形为吸水芯留出空腔，而水箱的提手

cues.en: then becomes the air intake. Quite clever.
cues.zh: 随后变成进风口。挺巧妙。

cues.en: That said, this isn't a very good
cues.zh: 话虽如此，这可不是一台很好的

cues.en: humidifier.
cues.zh: 加湿器。

cues.en: It just isn't capable of all that much output. It takes about two days running at its high setting to go through the entire tank contrary to its up to twenty four hour run time. That makes it appropriate for small rooms but not much else. In fairness, they did say that on the box.
cues.zh: 它的出雾量实在不怎么样。开到高档位，整箱水大约要两天才能用完，而它标称的最长运行时间是二十四小时。所以它只适合小房间，别的就不太行了。平心而论，包装盒上确实写了这一点。

cues.en: Now I wanted to get something larger, something capable of humidifying my entire home.
cues.zh: 于是我想要一台更大的，一台能给我整个家加湿的。

cues.en: And it turns out that most whole house humidifiers use the same concept as this one but scaled up. Through them, I've apparently discovered one of those cases where the simplest idea
cues.zh: 结果发现，大多数全屋加湿器用的都是和这个相同的概念，只是规模放大了。通过它们，我显然发现了那种“最简单的想法”

cues.en: is the most effective.
cues.zh: 反而最有效的情况。

cues.en: Let's back up a minute. Why do I want a humidifier in the first place? Many of you across the world probably think that wanting to add moisture to the air is insane.
cues.zh: 先往回倒一下。我到底为什么想要加湿器？世界各地很多人可能觉得，想给空气加湿是疯了。

cues.en: You probably live someplace where it's hot and humid. Fun fact, it's hot and humid here, too! In the summer.
cues.zh: 你们可能住在又热又潮的地方。有趣的是，这里也又热又潮！夏天的时候。

cues.en: Yeah, we get the worst of both worlds. It's great. In the winter, though, nature conspires against us and makes the air often unbearably dry.
cues.zh: 是啊，我们两头的好处没占着，坏处全占了。真棒。不过到了冬天，大自然偏要跟我们作对，空气常常干得让人受不了。

cues.en: See, when we talk about humidity,
cues.zh: 你看，我们说到湿度时，

cues.en: we almost always talk in terms of relative humidity.
cues.zh: 几乎总是指相对湿度。

cues.en: It's expressed as a percentage, indicating how much moisture is in the air compared to the air's ability to hold moisture.
cues.zh: 它用百分比表示，说明空气中的水分含量相对于空气的持水能力有多少。

cues.en: When relative humidity is 50%,
cues.zh: 当相对湿度为50%时，

cues.en: the air is therefore holding half of the water that it can.
cues.zh: 空气因此只含有其最大持水量的一半。

cues.en: It's 50% moist.
cues.zh: 它的湿度是50%。

cues.en: When it's 100%,
cues.zh: 当达到100%时，

cues.en: the air is fully saturated and can no longer take on any moisture.
cues.zh: 空气就完全饱和了，无法再吸收任何水分。

cues.en: We use relative humidity because it correlates with how our bodies, and in fact pretty much everything,
cues.zh: 我们使用相对湿度，是因为它和我们身体，实际上几乎一切事物，

cues.en: feels humidity.
cues.zh: 感受湿度的方式相关。

cues.en: But, and here's where nature sneaks up on you, the ability for air to hold moisture varies with its temperature.
cues.zh: 但是，大自然会在这里让你措手不及：空气容纳水分的能力会随其温度变化。

cues.en: Warm air can hold more moisture than cold air. At 20 degrees Celsius or 68 Fahrenheit,
cues.zh: 暖空气比冷空气能容纳更多水分。在20摄氏度（68华氏度）时，

cues.en: one kilogram of air can hold approximately 15 grams of water vapor.
cues.zh: 一千克空气大约能容纳15克水蒸气。

cues.en: At zero degrees Celsius or 32 Fahrenheit, it can only hold about five grams, roughly a third.
cues.zh: 在摄氏0度（华氏32度）时，它只能容纳约5克，约为三分之一。

cues.en: That means that at the same relative humidity, say 50%,
cues.zh: 这意味着在相同相对湿度下，比如50%，

cues.en: the air outside can only hold a third of the moisture that the air in your home can.
cues.zh: 室外空气能容纳的水分只有你家里空气的三分之一。

cues.en: Now because the air in your home is ultimately the same air as outside,
cues.zh: 由于家里的空气归根结底和室外是同一股空气，

cues.en: you're at the mercy of how humid the outdoor air is.
cues.zh: 你就只能受室外空气湿度左右。

cues.en: And when you heat that air up to make a living space more comfortable, you increase its ability to hold moisture but not the actual amount of moisture it contains.
cues.zh: 而当你把空气加热，让居住空间更舒适时，你提高的是它容纳水分的能力，而不是它实际含有的水分量。

cues.en: This makes relative humidity plummet.
cues.zh: 这会令相对湿度骤降。

cues.en: At freezing point, even if the air outside is at 100%
cues.zh: 在冰点温度下，即使室外空气的湿度是 100%，

cues.en: humidity when you warm it to a comfortable indoor air temperature,
cues.zh: 当你把它加热到舒适的室内温度时，

cues.en: now the relative humidity is just 33%.
cues.zh: 此时相对湿度就只有 33% 了。

cues.en: It didn't lose any moisture,
cues.zh: 它并没有失去任何水分，

cues.en: it's just able to hold more, and that makes it feel drier.
cues.zh: 只是能容纳更多水分，这就让人感觉更干燥。

cues.en: This gets worse the colder it becomes outside.
cues.zh: 室外越冷，这种情况就越严重。

cues.en: Since where I live it's not uncommon for the outdoor air temperature to be between zero and ten degrees Fahrenheit
cues.zh: 因为我住的地方，室外气温在 0 到 10 华氏度之间并不罕见

cues.en: (that's about minus 18 to minus 12 Celsius),
cues.zh: （大约是零下 18 到零下 12 摄氏度），

cues.en: indoor air can sometimes be desert levels of dry.
cues.zh: 室内空气有时会干到沙漠的程度。

cues.en: This is obviously uncomfortable,
cues.zh: 这显然让人不舒服，

cues.en: leads to things like peeling skin and chapped lips, often makes your throat scratchy, it makes static shocks happen all the dang time, and seems to be a contributing factor to viral spread
cues.zh: 会导致皮肤脱皮、嘴唇干裂，常常让嗓子发痒，还老是让人被静电电到，而且似乎是病毒传播的一个促成因素

cues.en: although we don't quite understand why yet. One hypothesis is that drier air allows airborne droplets containing virus particles to remain suspended for longer since those droplets dry out quickly and remain afloat more easily with less mass.
cues.zh: 尽管我们还不完全明白原因。一种假设是，更干燥的空气会让携带病毒颗粒的空气飞沫悬浮更久，因为飞沫会迅速变干，质量变小后更容易漂浮。

cues.en: But that's just one explanation and in any case it's not important to this video.
cues.zh: 但这只是一种解释，而且不管怎样，它对这个视频并不重要。

cues.en: It's just another way dry air sucks.
cues.zh: 它只是干燥空气吸水的另一种方式。

cues.en: Anyway, the only way we can get relative humidity to go back up after heating the outside air is to add moisture into the air ourselves.
cues.zh: 总之，加热室外空气后，想让相对湿度回升，唯一的办法就是我们自己往空气里加湿。

cues.en: And that's what humidifiers are for. You add water to them and they make it evaporate into the air to increase relative humidity.
cues.zh: 加湿器就是干这个的。你给它们加水，它们让水蒸发到空气中，从而提高相对湿度。

cues.en: And of course, there are multiple types of humidifiers.
cues.zh: 当然，加湿器有很多种类型。

cues.en: Shall we talk about them? Let's talk about them! Including one you can make yourself.
cues.zh: 要聊聊它们吗？那就聊聊吧！还包括一个你可以自己动手做的。

cues.en: This is the ol' standby Vicks warm mist style thingamabob.
cues.zh: 这是老牌常备的 Vicks 暖雾式小玩意儿。

cues.en: It's in two parts, a weirdly shaped plastic jug which contains the water and is nearly impossible to effectively clean,
cues.zh: 它分两部分：一个形状古怪的塑料壶，用来装水，而且几乎没法有效清洗，

cues.en: and,
cues.zh: 还有，

cues.en: this doohickey which sits in the water.
cues.zh: 这个泡在水里的小装置。

cues.en: All
cues.zh: 它

cues.en: this does is slowly boil water.
cues.zh: 能做的只是慢慢把水烧开。

cues.en: Seriously. That's that's all it does.
cues.zh: 说真的。它真的就只干这个。

cues.en: And they're really finicky too. If your water doesn't have enough minerals in it, it won't work and they have to put a label on here saying hey if this doesn't start working in ten minutes try adding some salt, see if that helps.
cues.zh: 而且它们还特别娇气。如果水里的矿物质不够，它就不会工作，所以他们只好在这儿贴个标签，写着：嘿，如果这玩意儿十分钟内还没开始工作，试试加点盐，看看有没有用。

cues.en: If it's not clear I don't really care for these but after all they're not marketed as humidifiers
cues.zh: 可能不太明显：我其实不太喜欢这些，但毕竟它们并不是作为加湿器来卖的

cues.en: exactly,
cues.zh: 没错，

cues.en: they're more of a personal care product meant to be used in conjunction with Vic's latest cold fighting rubs or whatever.
cues.zh: 它们更像是个人护理产品，本来就是要配合 Vic's 最新的抗感冒药膏之类的东西使用。

cues.en: But the main reason I don't like them is simply that boiling water is a rather energy intensive method of vaporizing it. This uses about 50 watts continuously which,
cues.zh: 但我不喜欢它们的主要原因很简单：把水烧开是一种相当耗能的汽化方式。这个会持续消耗大约 50 瓦，而这……

cues.en: yeah, that's not a whole lot. Turns out it's much worse than this. I was somewhat suspicious that it was only drawing 50 watts, so when shooting the b roll for this video I decided to descale the thing with vinegar.
cues.zh: 是啊，这不算多。结果发现情况比这糟得多。我有点怀疑它只消耗 50 瓦，所以在拍这个视频的 B-roll 时，我决定用醋给它除垢。

cues.en: This is all the lovely crud that came out of it. Yummy.
cues.zh: 这就是从里面出来的那些“可爱”污垢。真美味。

cues.en: After this descaling, it's now producing more steam and pulling 200
cues.zh: 除垢之后，它现在产生的蒸汽更多了，功耗达到 200

cues.en: watts.
cues.zh: 瓦。

cues.en: That's a lot.
cues.zh: 这可不少。

cues.en: And I've apparently uncovered something of a mystery.
cues.zh: 看来我还发现了一个谜团。

cues.en: Its power consumption is just weird.
cues.zh: 它的功耗就是很奇怪。

cues.en: It seems to slowly rise when you plug it in, and if you remove it from the water it instantly falls to practically zero.
cues.zh: 插上电后，它似乎会慢慢上升；而一旦把它从水里拿出来，就会立刻降到几乎为零。

cues.en: I'm starting to wonder if this thing is actually an electrode boiler. That would help explain the need for salt in some circumstances.
cues.zh: 我开始怀疑这东西其实是个电极锅炉。这也能解释为什么在某些情况下需要加盐。

cues.en: I've been trying to find a concrete answer online but without much success. So, I'll be taking this thing apart in a quick and dirty video on my second channel. A link will be below. I do just want to say though that I've sold its ability to humidify a little short.
cues.zh: 我一直在网上找确切答案，但没太大收获。所以我会在第二频道做个简单粗暴的视频，把这东西拆开。链接会放在下面。不过我得说，我之前有点低估了它的加湿能力。

cues.en: It will, assuming it's operating correctly, go through a gallon in twelve hours, which is fairly substantial output.
cues.zh: 如果运行正常，它12小时会用掉一加仑，这个输出相当可观。

cues.en: It will just use a lot of energy in the process, and I stand by my statement that these are finicky and annoying.
cues.zh: 只不过过程中会耗很多电，我依然坚持我的说法：这些东西又娇气又烦人。

cues.en: Another common style of humidifier is this one, the ultrasonic cool mist variety.
cues.zh: 另一种常见的加湿器是这种超声波冷雾型。

cues.en: This is in my opinion certainly the most interesting style of humidifier.
cues.zh: 在我看来，这绝对是最有趣的加湿器类型。

cues.en: A piezoelectric
cues.zh: 一个压电

cues.en: disc sits at the bottom of the pool of water. A very high frequency signal in the megahertz range is fed to this disc which causes it to vibrate at that frequency.
cues.zh: 圆盘位于水槽底部。兆赫兹范围内的极高频信号被馈入这个圆盘，使其以该频率振动。

cues.en: This causes micron sized water droplets to form on the surface of the water, and a small fan draws in air from below the device and pushes it out through this tube.
cues.zh: 这会使水表面形成微米大小的水滴，小风扇从设备下方吸入空气，并通过这个管子将其吹出。

cues.en: When the tank sits on the base, the airflow carries these tiny water droplets up through this hole in the tank, and a little hat with a nozzle helps direct that water and air mixture upward and outward.
cues.zh: 当水箱放在底座上时，气流会把这些微小水滴向上带过水箱上的这个孔，而一个带喷嘴的小盖会帮助把水和空气的混合物向上、向外导出去。

cues.en: What comes out of here are microscopic droplets of water suspended in the air, that's why they're visible. In a sense, this thing generates clouds.
cues.zh: 从这里出来的是悬浮在空气中的微小水滴，所以看得见。某种意义上，这东西是在造云。

cues.en: But they quickly disappear.
cues.zh: 但它们很快就会消失。

cues.en: The miniscule size of the droplets means that they'll evaporate nearly instantly and thus the relative humidity of the air in the room will go up. These humidifiers are fairly effective. This particular unit will go through its tank of water in about twenty four hours. They also don't require all that much energy. At its maximum output, this unit consumes about 32 watts, though it is adjustable.
cues.zh: 水滴极小，意味着它们几乎会立刻蒸发，因此房间里空气的相对湿度会升高。这些加湿器相当有效。这台设备大约 24 小时就能用完一箱水。它们也不需要太多能量。在最大输出下，这台设备耗电约 32 瓦，不过功率可调。

cues.en: But these aren't perfect. There's always a catch. If you have hard water, the mineral content of your water ends up in the air. Because the water is thrown into the air as liquid water and evaporates after it exits the device, you can experience a white dust forming on objects, particularly near the humidifier itself.
cues.zh: 但这些并不完美。总有个坑。如果你用的是硬水，水里的矿物质最终会跑到空气中。因为水是以液态被喷到空中，并在离开设备后蒸发，所以你会看到物体上形成白色粉尘，尤其是在加湿器附近。

cues.en: This is the same limescale that you deal with in your sinks and shower but now it's all over the place. That's neat.
cues.zh: 这和你家水槽、淋浴间里要处理的水垢是同一种，只不过现在到处都是。真不错。

cues.en: Now that particular problem can be solved by filling the tank with distilled water purchased at a store, but that's annoying and also becomes a significant expense if you need to fill it daily and or have multiple units. There's also the fun fact that whatever mold, bacteria, chemical impurities, or other goodness might be in the water tank
cues.zh: 这个问题其实可以通过在商店购买蒸馏水来加满水箱解决，但这很麻烦，而且如果每天都要加水，或者有多台设备，花费也会相当可观。还有一个有趣的事实：水箱里无论是霉菌、细菌、化学杂质还是其他什么好东西

cues.en: will end up in the air, too. I'm I'm pointing right at it.
cues.zh: 最终都会进入空气中。我，我正指着它呢。

cues.en: Now, to be clear this isn't a gigantic concern and it's certainly not unique to ultrasonic humidifiers.
cues.zh: 先说清楚，这不是什么天大的问题，也绝不是超声波加湿器独有的。

cues.en: And then, of course, the last common style you can buy in stores is this kind. Invisible cool mist is marketing speak for evaporative.
cues.zh: 当然，最后一种在商店里能买到的常见类型就是这种。“隐形冷雾”是蒸发式的营销说法。

cues.en: Evaporative humidifiers simply help water evaporate by providing it with a large surface area to cling to and a flow of air for it to hitchhike upon.
cues.zh: 蒸发式加湿器就是给水提供大片可附着的表面和一股可搭便车的气流，帮它蒸发。

cues.en: They are extremely simple yet also extremely effective.
cues.zh: 它们极其简单，却也极其有效。

cues.en: You're right. I said this one wasn't very effective,
cues.zh: 你说得对。我说过这个效果不太好，

cues.en: but here's why. This
cues.zh: 但原因在这里。这个

cues.en: is its wick, right? And
cues.zh: 是它的吸水芯，对吧？而

cues.en: this is the wick of a whole house humidifier.
cues.zh: 这是一个全屋加湿器的吸水芯。

cues.en: See the difference?
cues.zh: 看出区别了吗？

cues.en: Here's the humidifier this giant wick belongs to. It's brown and therefore excellent.
cues.zh: 这个巨型吸水芯属于这台加湿器。它呈棕色，所以非常出色。

cues.en: This style of humidifier is sometimes referred to as a console humidifier and it is conceptually identical to the little Walmart one but scaled up and improved in a number of ways.
cues.zh: 这种加湿器有时被称为柜式加湿器，它在概念上与沃尔玛那台小的完全相同，但尺寸更大，并在很多方面做了改进。

cues.en: That said, I'm not entirely thrilled with it and I'll discuss my many quibbles as we go along. It is, however, undeniably
cues.zh: 话虽如此，我并没有完全满意，过程中会聊聊我的诸多小意见。不过不可否认，

cues.en: excellent at its job.
cues.zh: 它干这活儿非常出色。

cues.en: The device itself is little more than a large plastic box on wheels with simulated wood grain excellence and a fan. The fan sits on top of the box and when running pulls air through this vent in the rear and blows it out the top. The wick sits directly in front of that vent, and you'll notice that the vent doesn't go all the way to the bottom. That's because, of course, the wick needs to sit in a pool of water, and a vent going to the very bottom would kinda ruin that prospect. You can see that the water level isn't much lower than the bottom of the vent which makes moving this thing wonderfully stressful.
cues.zh: 这设备本身不过是个带轮子的大塑料箱，配了精美的仿木纹饰面和一个风扇。风扇在箱顶，运行时从后部通风口抽气，再从顶部吹出。吸水芯正好位于那个通风口前方，你会注意到通风口没有一直通到底部。当然，这是因为吸水芯需要泡在一池水里，通风口若一直通到底，就没法这样泡水了。你能看到水位并不比通风口底部低多少，这让搬动这家伙变得格外让人提心吊胆。

cues.en: And with that, here comes my first quibble.
cues.zh: 说到这里，我的第一个小抱怨来了。

cues.en: The box claims this has a 5.4 gallon capacity
cues.zh: 包装盒声称它有 5.4 加仑容量

cues.en: which is ridiculously
cues.zh: 这简直离谱地

cues.en: misleading. See? This is its water tank. This is two and a half gallons. Roughly three gallons sits in the bottom of the humidifier,
cues.zh: 误导人。看到了吗？这是它的水箱。这是 2.5 加仑。大约 3 加仑位于加湿器底部，

cues.en: but that level is kept constant by this bottle feeding it. When the bottle runs out, it will continue to run for a little while and use up some of the water in the bottom, but that makes filling it a two step process filling the bottom of the humidifier itself and then the bottle. You could just fill the bottle but then you'd need to immediately do it again after it emptied at least some of its contents to fill the bottom back up to the correct level.
cues.zh: 但这个水位靠这个瓶子给它供水来保持恒定。瓶子空了以后，它还会继续运行一小会儿，并消耗掉底部的一些水，但这让加水变成了两步：先给加湿器底部加水，再给瓶子加水。你可以只给瓶子加水，但瓶子至少倒空一部分后，你马上又得再装一次，才能把底部补回正确水位。

cues.en: Even worse is that a float switch prevents it from running when the water gets just an inch or so below the full level, meaning you could never get it to actually output 5.4 gallons of water in one go.
cues.zh: 更糟的是，浮子开关会在水位比满水位低一英寸左右时就阻止它运行，这意味着你永远没法让它一次真正输出5.4加仑水。

cues.en: Therefore, in my opinion, for all intents and purposes, this has a two and a half gallon capacity.
cues.zh: 所以，在我看来，不管怎么说，这实际容量就是2.5加仑。

cues.en: And aside from this particular numbers nonsense, the bottle itself isn't the best. I routinely have to reseat this cap or else it will leak, a mishap that would result in the bottom being overfilled and water spilling out the back.
cues.zh: 而且除了这种数字上的胡扯，瓶子本身也不怎么样。我经常得重新扣好这个盖子，否则就会漏水；一旦漏了，底部会被灌得太满，水还会从后面溢出来。

cues.en: This
cues.zh: 这

cues.en: thing certainly ain't without its problems.
cues.zh: 东西当然不是没有问题。

cues.en: How's that for a product endorsement? Anyway, here's where things get slightly interesting.
cues.zh: 这算哪门子的产品推荐？总之，接下来就有点意思了。

cues.en: The fan isn't just an ordinary fan, it is a fan controlled by a humidistat.
cues.zh: 这风扇不是普通风扇，而是由湿度控制器控制的。

cues.en: A pair of dials, one of them also being pressable as a button, serve as a basic user interface.
cues.zh: 一对旋钮，其中一个还能按下当按钮，构成基本用户界面。

cues.en: It's blue.
cues.zh: 它是蓝色的。

cues.en: Blue. Why does it have to be blue? And so bright?
cues.zh: 蓝色。为什么非得是蓝色？还这么亮？

cues.en: Manufacturers
cues.zh: 制造商

cues.en: of apparently literally everything now cut it out.
cues.zh: 几乎什么都造的厂商，现在都别这样了。

cues.en: Nobody needs this. It needs to be readable, not eye piercing. Geez, what if this were in my bedroom? Don't you think I ought to be able to, like, sleep?
cues.zh: 没人需要这东西。它得看得清，而不是刺眼。天哪，要是这玩意儿放我卧室里呢？你不觉得我应该能，呃，睡觉吗？

cues.en: You didn't even put it on the box. It's not like you thought you'd make another sale by being hip and with it with blue LEDs.
cues.zh: 你甚至都没把它印在包装盒上。你又不是觉得靠蓝色 LED 装潮、紧跟潮流就能多卖一台。

cues.en: Bring back dull, boring, red, amber, maybe green displays. Please. I am so over this.
cues.zh: 把那种暗淡、无聊的红色、琥珀色，也许还有绿色的显示灯带回来吧。拜托。我真是受够了。

cues.en: Where was I? Right. So atrocious display aside, which I will just go ahead and fix right now by applying a light dim decal up top I truly cannot believe this product needs to exist, yes I will get beyond this tangent,
cues.zh: 我说到哪儿了？对。先撇开这糟糕的显示不谈——我现在就在上面贴个遮光贴把它搞定。我真不敢相信这种产品居然有存在的必要。好，我不跑题了，

cues.en: you can select between four fan speeds and set the desired relative humidity in increments of 5%.
cues.zh: 你可以选择四档风速，并以 5% 为步进设置目标相对湿度。

cues.en: Built into the power cord is a hygrometer which it will use to measure the relative humidity and the onboard microcontroller
cues.zh: 电源线里内置了一个湿度计，用来测量相对湿度，而板载微控制器

cues.en: will cycle the fan on and off accordingly.
cues.zh: 会据此让风扇循环启停。

cues.en: The fan will turn on when humidity is three percent below the setpoint, and it will turn back off when it's achieved 1% above.
cues.zh: 湿度比设定值低 3 个百分点时风扇开启，比设定值高 1 个百分点时关闭。

cues.en: One thing I've been genuinely surprised by is how accurate basic hygrometers apparently are these days. The humidifier's display reads within just a couple of percentage points of both this analog dial and what my smart thermostat reports to me. Honestly a little surprising but anyway the benefit of having a humidistat is tremendous.
cues.zh: 真正让我意外的是，现在的基础湿度计显然已经相当准确。加湿器显示屏的读数，与这个模拟表盘以及智能恒温器报告的数值，都只差两三个百分点。说实话有点意外，但不管怎样，有湿度控制器带来的好处太大了。

cues.en: Being able to self regulate means it can respond to different conditions appropriately and keep humidity levels constant.
cues.zh: 能自我调节，意味着它能对不同条件做出恰当响应，并保持湿度水平恒定。

cues.en: And it's been very interesting to observe. I have it placed in a central location near my thermostat,
cues.zh: 观察起来非常有意思。我把它放在中央位置，靠近恒温器，

cues.en: and when the heat isn't running, neither is the humidifier.
cues.zh: 暖气不运行时，加湿器也不运行。

cues.en: But within just a few minutes of the heat kicking on, the relative humidity falls to the point that it needs to run. This makes perfect sense because the now warmer air can absorb more moisture, therefore its relative humidity has fallen slightly.
cues.zh: 但暖气一启动，几分钟内相对湿度就降到需要运行的程度。这很好理解，因为空气变暖后能吸收更多水分，所以相对湿度就略有下降。

cues.en: The humidifier will continue to run for about five minutes after the heat has shut off, and then it will have satisfied the humidity setpoint and go idle.
cues.zh: 暖气关闭后，加湿器还会继续运行大约五分钟，然后就会达到湿度设定值并停止运行。

cues.en: What's really fascinating is that it has
cues.zh: 真正有意思的是，它

cues.en: consistent reading as the temperature gradually falls.
cues.zh: 随着温度逐渐下降，读数始终保持一致。

cues.en: I have it set to 50%, and after stopping at 51 it may fall back down to 50 or perhaps even 49%,
cues.zh: 我把它设定在50%，在51%停住之后，它可能会回落到50%，甚至49%，

cues.en: but no more. It takes until the heat comes back on for the humidity to fall beyond that point, and this appears to be the case throughout the house according to my little hygrometer friend.
cues.zh: 但不会更低。要等到暖气重新开启，湿度才会跌破这个水平，而根据我这个小湿度计朋友的说法，整栋房子似乎都是这样。

cues.en: I'm actually genuinely curious about this because it seems moisture leaves the air at a rate correlated to its temperature drop.
cues.zh: 我其实真的很好奇，因为水分离开空气的速度似乎与其温度下降的速度相关。

cues.en: I run my thermostat on a program so that the temperature cools down by four degrees night, and even then the humidifier won't run until the heat comes on again and that can be hours later. Humidity stays right near 50%
cues.zh: 我把恒温器设了程序，让温度在夜间下降四度，但即便如此，加湿器也要等到再次供暖时才会运行，而那可能是几小时后了。湿度一直保持在50%左右

cues.en: the entire time the temperature is falling.
cues.zh: 在整个温度下降的过程中。

cues.en: It's fascinating, though at the moment it's not terribly cold yet so perhaps this behavior won't last.
cues.zh: 这很有趣，不过目前天气还不算特别冷，所以也许这种现象不会持续太久。

cues.en: Anyway, though this thing is ugly and annoys me in several ways it is undeniably great at humidifying,
cues.zh: 不过，虽然这东西很丑，还有几处让我烦，但它在加湿方面确实没得说，

cues.en: especially from an energy standpoint.
cues.zh: 尤其是从能耗角度看。

cues.en: Its fan is quite large so it uses the most energy of any humidifier we've seen so far while it's running
cues.zh: 它的风扇挺大，所以运行时是我们目前见过的最耗电的加湿器

cues.en: (about 65 watts at its low fan speed), but it only needs to run for about six hours on a typical day, and that's on its lowest fan speed. With my current usage, it goes through the entire two and a half gallon bottle daily.
cues.zh: （低档风速下约 65 瓦），但典型情况下每天只需运行约六小时，而且还是最低档风速。按我目前的使用情况，它每天会用完整整 2.5 加仑的水箱。

cues.en: Do the math there and we find it uses 144
cues.zh: 算一下就知道，它用了144

cues.en: watt hours per gallon.
cues.zh: 瓦时每加仑。

cues.en: Certainly a weird metric but hey, it works. The ultrasonic mister takes the same amount of time to go through one gallon at 32 watts continuously
cues.zh: 这指标确实挺怪，但嘿，管用。超声波雾化器以32瓦连续运行，消耗一加仑所需的时间相同

cues.en: which means it uses 768
cues.zh: 也就是说它用了768

cues.en: watt hours per gallon. That's more than five times the energy per unit of humidification.
cues.zh: 瓦时每加仑。单位加湿量的能耗是前者的五倍多。

cues.en: Oh, and the standby power consumption of this large unit is excellent, only about a third of a watt.
cues.zh: 哦对了，这台大机器的待机功耗非常出色，只有约三分之一瓦。

cues.en: Despite that garish display.
cues.zh: 尽管那个显示屏很花哨。

cues.en: My old dishwasher used triple that.
cues.zh: 我以前的洗碗机用的水是它的三倍。

cues.en: Honestly, it's amazing how much water this thing adds to the air when it runs. Just feeling the air coming out of it is impressive. It's downright swampy.
cues.zh: 说实话，这东西运行时往空气里加的水分多得惊人。光感受它排出的空气就很震撼。简直湿得像沼泽。

cues.en: Leaving the hygrometer on the top reveals that the air it supplies is at least 70%
cues.zh: 把湿度计放在顶部，会发现它送出的空气至少有70%

cues.en: humidity.
cues.zh: 湿度。

cues.en: To give you a sense of how fast it goes through water, well you can hear the bottle go as
cues.zh: 让你感受一下它耗水有多快，嗯，你能听到水瓶发出咕噜声，当

cues.en: it replenishes the water level.
cues.zh: 它补充水位的时候。

cues.en: And this happens more frequently than every five minutes when it's running. It's amazing.
cues.zh: 而且它运行时，这种情况发生的频率比每五分钟一次还高。太惊人了。

cues.en: This thing is just excellent at getting liquid water to evaporate with nothing but airflow.
cues.zh: 这东西非常擅长只靠气流就让液态水蒸发。

cues.en: Setting this thing up has frankly been a little astonishing to me. It's so simple yet extraordinarily
cues.zh: 说实话，把这个东西设置好让我有点惊讶。它如此简单，却又极其

cues.en: effective. Using less energy over a day than this little ultrasonic humidifier, it's able to take care of my entire home and not just a single room. I've been checking with my hygrometer and indeed humidity is pretty consistent from room to room, varying only by about 5%.
cues.zh: 有效。它一天用的电比这个小超声波加湿器还少，却能照顾我整个家，而不只是一个房间。我一直用湿度计检查，确实各个房间的湿度相当一致，只相差约 5%。

cues.en: Granted, this is ridiculous overkill for the size of my home and I do have the benefit of the forced air furnace to help move air around,
cues.zh: 我承认，对我家的面积来说这实在是离谱地过剩，而且我确实有强制送风暖炉帮忙带动空气流通，

cues.en: but it really seems that evaporative humidifiers are, at least in many respects,
cues.zh: 但看起来，蒸发式加湿器至少在很多方面，

cues.en: the best.
cues.zh: 是最好的。

cues.en: Of course, there's a catch.
cues.zh: 当然，有个问题。

cues.en: And it's,
cues.zh: 而且它，

cues.en: kinda big.
cues.zh: 有点大。

cues.en: Evaporative humidifiers can get gross.
cues.zh: 蒸发式加湿器会变得很脏。

cues.en: To be clear, all humidifiers
cues.zh: 说清楚点，所有加湿器

cues.en: get gross over time but the evaporative style tends to present the most opportunities for grossness because there's a giant damp sponge sitting in a pool of water that has air forced through it by a fan and thus everyone's favorite mold spores and bacteria
cues.zh: 时间久了都会变脏，但蒸发式往往最容易变脏，因为有一大块湿海绵泡在水里，风扇把空气吹过它，于是大家最爱的霉菌孢子和细菌

cues.en: are brought right to a lovely place to live. It's crate.
cues.zh: 就被直接带到一个宜居的好地方。太棒了。

cues.en: Now, there are ways to combat this problem. First, the wicks are almost always meant to be replaced seasonally,
cues.zh: 现在有办法应对这个问题。首先，灯芯几乎总是要按季节更换的，

cues.en: and there are water treatment products available to inhibit bacterial growth. I've been using this for a while with regular water treatments,
cues.zh: 而且市面上有可抑制细菌生长的水处理产品。我用这个已经有一段时间了，并配合定期水处理，

cues.en: and so far no musty odor has developed which is the most common complaint of this style of humidifier.
cues.zh: 到目前为止还没出现霉味，而这是这类加湿器最常见的抱怨。

cues.en: The particular treatment I'm using is supposed to help with mineral buildup too but
cues.zh: 我采用的这种特定处理方式据说也有助于应对矿物质沉积，但是

cues.en: we'll see.
cues.zh: 我们拭目以待。

cues.en: But here's where I have good news. This is conceptually a very simple device and that means you can make one yourself.
cues.zh: 但好消息来了。从概念上讲，这是个非常简单的装置，也就是说你可以自己做一个。

cues.en: All you need is something to absorb water and provide it with a large surface area. And you have plenty of those.
cues.zh: 你只需要能吸水、又有很大表面积的东西。而这种东西你有很多。

cues.en: Towels! Take a large bowl, fill it maybe a third the way up with water, and submerge the center of a small towel.
cues.zh: 毛巾！拿一个大碗，装大约三分之一的水，把小毛巾的中间部分浸进去。

cues.en: You may need to weigh it down with something. Terrycloth is great for this, that's why towels help you dry things after all, they have lots of little fibers for water to cling to.
cues.zh: 你可能需要用东西把它压住。毛圈布很适合，毕竟毛巾能帮你擦干东西，就是因为它有很多细小纤维可以吸水。

cues.en: Those same fibers provide places for water to evaporate from.
cues.zh: 那些纤维本身也提供了水分蒸发的位置。

cues.en: Try experimenting with different bowls, towels, quantities of water, etcetera.
cues.zh: 可以试试不同的碗、毛巾、水量等等。

cues.en: To gauge the effectiveness of your invention, go ahead and grab one of these little hygrometers.
cues.zh: 要衡量你这项发明的效果，不妨拿一个这种小湿度计。

cues.en: They're not the most accurate things out there but plenty good for giving you guidance and they only cost around $5.
cues.zh: 它们不是最准确的，但用来给你提供参考足够了，而且只要大约 5 美元。

cues.en: You can speed up evaporation with a desk fan pointed at the towels,
cues.zh: 你可以用台式风扇对着毛巾吹，来加快蒸发，

cues.en: and best of all you can simply run this improvised wick material through the laundry and change it however frequently you'd like.
cues.zh: 最棒的是，你完全可以把这种临时灯芯材料扔进洗衣机洗，想多频繁更换都行。

cues.en: Now this isn't that effective, I won't lie, but a quick test in my roughly 100 square foot office showed it could maintain 50% humidity with the aid of a fan,
cues.zh: 说实话，这效果不算太好，但在我那间大约100平方英尺的办公室里做了个快速测试，结果显示借助风扇它能维持50%的湿度，

cues.en: and that was with a frankly awful
cues.zh: 而且说实话，那还是在相当糟糕的

cues.en: towel placement.
cues.zh: 毛巾摆放方式下实现的。

cues.en: What I'd love to see come to market is a sort of rack meant to hold towels, maybe a kitchen towel or shreds of towels, in a zig zag vertical arrangement sort of replicating this wick cartridge but with a washable towel rather than this paper honeycomb stuff.
cues.zh: 我很希望看到市场上出现一种用来挂毛巾的架子，也许挂一条厨房毛巾或几条毛巾条，以之字形垂直排列，有点像复刻这个吸水芯盒，但用的是可水洗毛巾，而不是这种纸质蜂窝材料。

cues.en: It probably wouldn't work as well as these paper wicks, but it would be a fun thing to try. Just put it in a shallow pan and sit it in front of a fan.
cues.zh: 它大概不如这些纸芯效果好，但试一下会挺有趣。只要把它放进浅盘里，再放到风扇前面。

cues.en: This might even push me to buy a decent three d printer.
cues.zh: 这甚至可能促使我去买一台像样的 3D 打印机。

cues.en: But good news for those of us who just can't be bothered, the same manufacturer of this large console makes what they call a mini console and it is delightfully simple.
cues.zh: 但对我们这些懒得折腾的人来说有个好消息：这款大型落地式加湿器的同一厂商还做了他们所谓的迷你加湿器，而且简单得让人愉快。

cues.en: It is little more than a bucket, a fan,
cues.zh: 它不过就是一个桶、一个风扇，

cues.en: and two wicks. The wicks are placed in these slots, a cowl sits between them, and a fan controlled by the exact same humidistat
cues.zh: 和两根吸水芯。吸水芯插在这些槽里，中间有个风罩，而风扇由同一个恒湿器控制

cues.en: forces air through the wicks when necessary. It takes in air through the sides and blows it out the top, nicely moistened.
cues.zh: 在需要时把空气吹过吸水芯。它从侧面吸入空气，再从顶部吹出，吹出来的空气湿润得恰到好处。

cues.en: This isn't as effective as the big brown beast over here simply because it's smaller,
cues.zh: 它没有这边这个棕色大块头那么有效，纯粹是因为它更小，

cues.en: but it's much, much more user friendly and also quieter, at least on its low fan speeds.
cues.zh: 但用起来友好得多，也安静得多，至少低风速下是这样。

cues.en: Filling it is as easy as filling a bucket because that's
cues.zh: 给它加水就像往水桶里加水一样简单，因为它就是

cues.en: what it is, just just take the fan off and carry this to a sink.
cues.zh: 一个水桶，只要把风扇拆下来，把它拿到水槽边就行。

cues.en: Much less finicky than dealing with a tank or jug,
cues.zh: 比折腾水箱或水壶省心多了，

cues.en: and a lot easier to clean.
cues.zh: 而且清洗也容易得多。

cues.en: Though in this case there's a weird quirk in that the more you fill it, the less effective it will be because less of the wick is exposed to air. It's probably best to keep the water level at about half the wick's height or less.
cues.zh: 不过它有个奇怪的特点：水装得越多，效果反而越差，因为露在空气中的吸水芯更少。最好把水位保持在吸水芯高度的一半左右或更低。

cues.en: Here's a pro tip for you should you decide to purchase a humidifier like these.
cues.zh: 如果你决定买这类加湿器，给你个实用小技巧。

cues.en: If you use a water treatment product which I highly recommend you do, put it in a soap pump. Figure out how many pumps it takes to fill, say, a tablespoon,
cues.zh: 如果你使用水质处理剂——我很推荐你用——就把它装进皂液泵里。先算算需要按多少泵才能装满，比如一汤匙，

cues.en: and use that to determine how many pumps you'll need every time you fill your humidifier.
cues.zh: 然后用这个数来确定每次给加湿器加水时需要按多少泵。

cues.en: It's much less messy and more consistent, too. I decided to purchase this amber glass pump just in case the chemicals in the solution are sensitive to light which, they probably aren't given the jug it comes in but you can absolutely just use a well cleaned out old soap pump.
cues.zh: 这样不容易弄得到处都是，用量也更一致。我决定买这个琥珀色玻璃泵瓶，以防溶液里的化学物质对光敏感——考虑到它原装桶的材质，大概并不敏感——但你完全可以用一个清洗干净的旧皂液泵。

cues.en: In this case I know I need to add 15 squirts every time I fill this bottle.
cues.zh: 这种情况下，我知道每次给这个瓶子加水时都要挤15下。

cues.en: Also, for whatever reason large humidifiers like these seem to only be available in hardware stores, at least in my neck of The US.
cues.zh: 另外，不知为什么，像这种大型加湿器似乎只在五金店才有卖，至少在美国我这一带是这样。

cues.en: Your general big box store like Walmart seems to only carry small single room units,
cues.zh: 像沃尔玛这种普通的大型连锁店似乎只卖小型单房间机型，

cues.en: though weirdly enough when I was last at Walmart they sold not only these exact hygrometers
cues.zh: 不过奇怪的是，我上次去沃尔玛时，他们不仅卖这种一模一样的湿度计，

cues.en: but the same water treatment chemical I'm using in these, too.
cues.zh: 而且还卖我在这些加湿器里用的同一种水处理剂。

cues.en: So yeah, don't don't know why that is exactly but I'd also recommend that you buy a few spare wicks for the years ahead. Any large hardware store should carry them, and to my fellow mid westerners,
cues.zh: 所以呢，我也不太确定这到底是什么原因，但我还是建议你多备几根滤芯，以备今后几年用。任何大型五金店应该都有卖，另外，中西部的小伙伴们，

cues.en: Menards had plenty.
cues.zh: Menards 有的是。

cues.en: So, that's about all I have to say here. Even though these evaporative humidifiers aren't the flashiest or most technically intriguing,
cues.zh: 那么，我要说的差不多就这些了。虽然这类蒸发式加湿器算不上最花哨、技术上也不算最有趣，

cues.en: they seem to do their job extremely effectively and efficiently.
cues.zh: 但它们干起活来似乎非常有效、也非常高效。

cues.en: I would like to suggest a few revisions to this particular design, though.
cues.zh: 不过，我想对这个具体设计提几点修改建议。

cues.en: What I'd love to see is a wick that is held much higher up, allowing the tank to hold more water, perhaps 10 or more gallons.
cues.zh: 我希望把吸水芯固定在更高的位置，这样水箱就能装更多水，也许 10 加仑甚至更多。

cues.en: Rather than requiring it to sit in a pool of water, I think it would be neat if a pump were used to bring water up to the wick.
cues.zh: 与其让它泡在水池里，我觉得用泵把水送到吸水芯上会挺不错。

cues.en: This is actually a fairly common design of large swamp coolers.
cues.zh: 这其实是大型蒸发式冷风机相当常见的设计。

cues.en: This design would allow it to run for days without stopping.
cues.zh: 这种设计能让它连续运行好几天不用停。

cues.en: I imagine one difficulty with this, aside from the simple fact that the pump then becomes a thing that can fail, is that this would make it a lot louder.
cues.zh: 我想这里的一个难点在于，抛开水泵本身会变成一个可能出故障的部件这一点不说，这还会让它吵很多。

cues.en: A method of catching the water so it didn't fall from a great height would need to be devised otherwise you'd hear a constant trickling from the thing when it runs.
cues.zh: 得想个办法把水接住，别让它从高处落下来，否则运行时你会一直听到滴答的水声。

cues.en: Plus, of course, this would add tubing and thus more places for mold and bacteria to find refuge.
cues.zh: 当然，这还会增加管路，也就多了更多让霉菌和细菌藏身的地方。

cues.en: So maybe it's not the best idea but I will say to the folks at AirCare that I really don't like the float switch on this unit.
cues.zh: 也许这不是最好的说法，但我想对AirCare的人说，我真的很不喜欢这台机器上的浮子开关。

cues.en: See, instead of using it to simply alert you that it's empty, it shuts the unit off.
cues.zh: 你看，它不是简单地提醒你水空了，而是直接关掉机器。

cues.en: I would much rather it continue running the fan when it runs out of water so that the wick can actually dry out.
cues.zh: 我更希望它没水时继续转风扇，好让灯芯能真正晾干。

cues.en: Turning the unit off means that stagnant water will stick behind both in the wick and in the bottom which is a little unsettling to me. Also, the implementation of it is just super janky. It's a stick with a styrofoam float that a ring on the wick cartridge keeps steady
cues.zh: 关掉机器意味着死水会留在灯芯和底部，这让我有点不安。而且它的实现方式特别粗糙。就是一根棍子加泡沫浮子，靠灯芯滤芯上的环保持稳定

cues.en: and then it pokes the underside of the fan.
cues.zh: 然后它会戳到风扇底部。

cues.en: I'll probably just disable that switch, maybe force the stick thing up all the time by putting a rock under it or something.
cues.zh: 我大概会直接禁用那个开关，可能再垫块石头之类的，让那根杆一直顶上去。

cues.en: The simple bucket one for what it's worth has no float switch so it'll just run to its heart's content no matter what the water level is.
cues.zh: 顺带一提，那个简单的桶式没有浮球开关，所以不管水位多高，它都会一直尽情运行。

cues.en: I much prefer that.
cues.zh: 我更喜欢那样。

cues.en: Now before I go I do want to address that these sorts of portable units are by no means your only option.
cues.zh: 不过在走之前，我想说明一下，这类便携式设备绝不是你唯一的选择。

cues.en: Whole home humidifiers
cues.zh: 全屋加湿器

cues.en: that get installed into your home's HVAC system are also fairly common,
cues.zh: 安装在家里 HVAC 系统中的那种也很常见，

cues.en: and wouldn't you know it, those are evaporative, too. These units will divert some of the air flowing through your ductwork through themselves and are plumped into a water supply. There's often an absorbent pad or wheel which also requires periodic replacement,
cues.zh: 而且你还真别说，那些也是蒸发式的。这些设备会把流经风管的一部分空气引入自身，并接入供水。通常还有一个吸水垫或转轮，也需要定期更换，

cues.en: though sometimes non porous materials are used which only require cleaning.
cues.zh: 不过，有时也会使用非多孔材料，这种材料只需清洁。

cues.en: Still, though, if you've been using one of these and haven't ever opened it up,
cues.zh: 不过，如果你一直在用这类设备，却从没打开过它，

cues.en: you might want to look into that. Since I didn't already have one of these in my HVAC system I just went for a standalone unit. And despite its many little annoyances,
cues.zh: 你也许该查一查。我的 HVAC 系统里本来就没有这类设备，所以我直接买了台独立式设备。尽管它有不少小毛病，

cues.en: I'm overall very happy with it. Certainly it's made the winter much more bearable. My lips were starting to get badly chapped around Christmas time but now that I have this running,
cues.zh: 总体而言我很满意。它确实让这个冬天好过多了。圣诞节前后我的嘴唇开始严重干裂，但现在我让这台设备一直开着，

cues.en: that's gone away.
cues.zh: 干裂已经好了。

cues.en: Usually it'd be chapstick time.
cues.zh: Usually it'd be chapstick time.

cues.en: And genuinely I feel warmer now with the thermostat set to the same temperature.
cues.zh: 说真的，恒温器温度没变，我现在却觉得更暖和了。

cues.en: I I don't know why this surprises me, as after all humid air always feels more oppressive in the summer and drier air feels cooler,
cues.zh: 我……我不知道自己为什么这么惊讶，毕竟夏天潮湿的空气总让人更闷，干燥的空气则感觉更凉爽，

cues.en: but it it did surprise me. The air is just much more comfortable in so many ways.
cues.zh: 但我确实很惊讶。空气在很多方面都舒服太多了。

cues.en: If you want to see how a humidifier might help you,
cues.zh: 如果你想看看加湿器能怎么帮到你，

cues.en: why not try and make your own first?
cues.zh: 何不先试着自己做一个呢？

cues.en: It'll at least give you something fun to do.
cues.zh: 至少能让你有点好玩的事可做。

cues.en: Anyway, toodles!
cues.zh: 总之，回见啦！

cues.en: This
cues.zh: 这个

cues.en: is what purports to be...
cues.zh: 据称是……

cues.en: Yeah. No. It's facing the right way. Shouldn't have second guessed myself.
cues.zh: 对。不。朝向是对的。我不该怀疑自己。

cues.en: Plastic base supports...
cues.zh: 塑料底座支撑着……

cues.en: Shoot.
cues.zh: 糟了。

cues.en: That was going great. Sits in a shallow pool of water and capillary action.
cues.zh: 本来进展得很顺利。它置于浅水池中，靠毛细作用。

cues.en: That makes it appropriate for small rooms, but not a lot much else. Not much else. Why did I say a lot much? That's dumb. Yeah. That's not a whole lot, but it's also not...
cues.zh: 这让它适合小房间，但除此之外用途不大。没多大别的用。我为什么说“a lot much”？真傻。是啊，那不算多，但也不是……

cues.en: The cat is having fun upstairs.
cues.zh: 猫在楼上玩得挺开心。

cues.en: But it's also not gonna be
cues.zh: 但它也不会

cues.en: it's not gonna be too much. Why does it have to be blue and so bright?
cues.zh: 不会太过火。为什么非得是蓝色的，还这么亮？

cues.en: No. That's way over the top.
cues.zh: 不行，那太过头了。
